one_liner: SEO and AI visibility data platform providing REST APIs and an official MCP server for rank tracking and search intelligence.
access_notes: API access requires an active SE Ranking subscription or API add-on/pay-as-you-go deposit.
verdict_reason: API keys are self-serve and instantly issued upon signing up and confirming email / purchasing a plan, but require a paid subscription or add-on/wallet deposit to execute calls.

evidence.snippet: Every request must be authenticated with your SE Ranking API key. Authentication is identical to the Data API and Project API: you can send the key in an Authorization header or as an apikey query parameter.
API access comes with any SE Ranking plan (Core at $129/mo and Growth at $279/mo). You can even test it in the free trial account.
The SE Ranking MCP server connects SE Ranking’s SEO data to AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.
SE Ranking secures its APIs with apiKey and oauth2 across 4 declared security schemes, as derived from its OpenAPI definitions.

agent_notes: SE Ranking provides robust REST endpoints for SEO and AI visibility analytics along with an official MCP server.
